system.description:
ATTACK FLOURISH

Action 0 AP; Trigger you successfully hit a creature with a melee or thrown weapon

You may make an additional attack against the same target. This attack is made as if it was your third strike of the turn (usually -10 but this may be lower based upon what feats you have). The attack does not count towards your MAP.

Automated: when your melee or thrown Strike hits and you may still use a Flourish this turn, you are asked whether to use Flow Strike: another Strike against the same target at your third-attack penalty (−10, −8 agile; −5 in Gale Cutter), which does not count towards your multiple attack penalty. 0 AP.
